source.name: Schaeffler: Jaguar TCS Racing Announces Schaeffler as Official Supplier (press release)
source.quote: Jaguar TCS Racing has joined forces with Schaeffler as Official Supplier on a multi-year agreement.
source.note: Named company press release, 19 March 2026 (Herzogenaurach), mid-season addition to the Season 12 partner network; Schaeffler also appears in the partner list on the club's partners page (jaguar.com/en-gb/jdx/jaguar-racing/our-partners.html).

summary: TCS is the title and technology partner (team name, front). Six further partners per the club's own Season 12 launch release (media.jlr.com, 22 Oct 2025) and its partners page on jaguar.com: Dow, Castrol, Chase, Alpinestars and Reflo (long-standing collaborations plus new partner Chase), and Schaeffler, which joined as Official Supplier in March 2026 (Schaeffler press release; club partners page).
